collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VII (121-140, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager's friend is good at everything, and today they discover the friend cannot whistle.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) is good at everything. Fishing, building, cooking, singing, telling stories. (subject) is (friend.his/her) friend, and (subject) is happy for (friend.him/her), and also, very privately, a tiny bit tired of it. Today, by sheer luck, they discover that (friend) cannot whistle. At all. (friend.He/She) purses (friend.his/her) lips and blows, and nothing comes out but air.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) shows (friend) how to shape (friend.his/her) lips and where to put (friend.his/her) tongue. (friend) is hopeless. It's wonderful. They spend the afternoon at it, and by sunset (friend) manages one thin, wobbly little note. (friend.He/She) is delighted. (subject) is delighted too, for (friend.him/her), and only very slightly smug.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) whistles a little tune, just once, very casually. Then (subject.he/she) says nothing at all. (friend) looks at (subject.him/her). "That's very good," (friend.he/she) says. "Thank you," says (subject). (subject.He/She) walks home feeling enormously cheerful and doesn't entirely know why. Actually, (subject.he/she) knows exactly why.
